ios.desc:
GIGA is an all-in-one manga reader that lets you read from websites, cloud storage, and local files in a single app.

## AI-Powered Site Setup
Just paste a manga site URL. AI automatically analyzes the site structure so you can start reading instantly. No manual configuration needed.

## Multiple Sources, One Library
• Websites — Add your favorite manga sites to the app
• Cloud Storage — Google Drive, OneDrive, and Dropbox
• Local Files — Supports PDF, CBZ, and ZIP formats (also accessible from iCloud Drive on iOS)

## Immersive Reading
A reader optimized for manga with smooth page navigation, slider controls, and dark mode support. Read comfortably anytime, anywhere.

## More Features
• Automatic reading history
• 10 languages supported
• Light/Dark theme
• iPad support

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
Hi HN! I'm itome. This is my first post on HN and English is not my first language so please bear with me.
I want to share a Rust-based cross-platform app framework I've been working on.
In short, it's a Rust version of React Native. You can build iOS, Android, web, and desktop (macOS for now) apps from a single Rust codebase.

I've built many apps with Flutter and React Native over the last 10 years and think they are super nice.  But they have limitations in memory usage, performance and app binary size. Some Flutter/React Native libraries solve those performance limitations by delegating processes to native code. So I came up with the idea of writing everything in native code, so you don't have to worry about those limitations.

I chose Rust for this project because I've already built some developer tools in Rust and think it's the future of programming (especially when you use it with AI).

The result is great. Whisker has good performance and a small footprint based on my early measurements. It has a human-readable render! macro and SolidJS-like fine-grained reactivity. It also has hot reloading, using a fork of Dioxus's subsecond.

Building a whole app framework is a huge amount of work. I'm using Codex and Claude Code to complete those tasks. Whisker would never have gotten this far without LLMs, but this project is not vibe coded. I decided all the APIs and the architecture.

It's in pre-alpha, so the APIs may change.

quotes.story_title: Show HN: Whisker – Build native iOS, Android, web and desktop apps in Rust
